To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
InFO WLP technology with state of art RF inductors can be used for heterogeneous integration of RF and digital components.

(1) InFO WLP technology can be used to integrate digital and RF components in a single package with superior form factor and thermal performance, (2) InFO WPL technology enables high Q inductance in a small area and (3) InFO WFP technology enables low power RF circuits.
InFO WLP is an attractive solution for the next generation of mobile devices.
